messages:
Alice M.: DeployBot detected a canary p95 latency spike on v3.6.0 in usw2 at 09:04 PT. DeployBot flagged p95=1.35s (+40% vs baseline). Holding auto-rollback; ops decision required.

DeployBot: AUTO-ROLLBACK_THRESHOLD HIT but withheld due to maintenance-window override. Suggested action: manual unwind or pin.

Ben R.: Do we see increased 5xx or error budget burn?

Carol S.: No, error rate flat. It's pure latency. KV cache miss rate up ~3x for that canary slice.

Ben R.: Could be kvcache eviction pressure from recent kernel patch in this build. Any quick mitigations? reduce concurrency or batch size?

Dave L.: Short term plan: scale canary slice down to 50% traffic in usw2 and pin Dedicated pools back to v3.5.7 for affected customers. I'll run the traffic change now.

Dave L.: ```sh
# shrink canary slice to 50% (usw2)
opsctl traffic set --release v3.6.0 --slice canary --pct 50 --region usw2
# pin dedicated customer pool
opsctl customer pin --customer acme-project --version v3.5.7
```

Emma (oncall): @Support Bot can you draft a short customer note for AcmeCorp + DataCo? Keep it calm: "holding rollout, no user-facing errors, investigating latency". Also update release notes. :email:

Support Bot: Drafted DM templates and added to #support-drafts. Template preview: "We're temporarily holding the v3.6.0 rollout in us-west-2 after an internal canary showed increased latency. We've reduced canary traffic and pinned your Dedicated pool to the previous stable release. No customer-facing errors observed; we'll follow up with a timeline once we have root cause."

Alice M.: Thanks. Adding a short release notes blurb now: "v3.6.0: Rollout held in us-west-2 due to elevated canary latency; canary traffic reduced to 50%; dedicated pools for select enterprise customers pinned to v3.5.7 while we investigate kv-cache-related regressions. No functional failures observed."

Ben R.: :thumbsup: Can you also capture the rollback criteria? My suggestion: full rollback if p95 stays >1.2s for 15m AND kvcache miss or CPU >85% on serving hosts.

Carol S.: Agreed. Add: automatic rollback allowed only outside maintenance window; during window require manual confirmation.

Dave L.: I executed the traffic commands. DeployBot event: traffic-split change applied. Status: canary=50% in usw2; dedicated pin applied to acme-project.

DeployBot: Update: traffic-split changed by Dave L. at 09:06 PT. New state: canary=50% (usw2). Auto-rollback still armed but awaiting ops evaluation.

Emma (oncall): I'll open a follow-up ticket (REL-3578) and set severity P2. Adding logs, p95 graphs, kvcache metrics, and the customer DM templates. ETA for first investigation triage: 09:18 PT.

Alice M.: Next check at 09:20 PT. If p95 drops below 1.15s, continue slow rollout. If not, we roll back fully to v3.5.7 for all regions or at least pause rollout globally.

Carol S.: Quick grep of the build shows a kernel memory limit toggle changed in this build's packaging. I'm going to reproduce locally against a small test cluster.

Dave L.: I'm drafting the full rollback playbook in the ticket (steps, who to notify, customer comms). If we need to execute full rollback: `opsctl release rollback --from v3.6.0 --to v3.5.7 --scope global --confirm` (requires two approvers).

Ben R.: Good. Also add an item to the playbook to run the kvcache warmup script before re-rollout.

Emma (oncall): Noted. Support has queued the DM and will send after confirmation from Alice.

Alice M.: Confirmed we wait until 09:20 PT, then decide. Thanks everyone — keep updates short in this thread. :white_check_mark:
